quest.guhs.ringh2.aankomst: Guhvendell! The Last Cozy House. You're safe here: no Mika, no Eye, just lots and lots of cheese sauce.
quest.guhs.ringh2.sam.aankomst: Would you look at those waterfalls! Made of REAL cheese sauce. I'll go put a little pan on by the Rest Fire, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.kennis.klaar: You know everyone now. Ring the bell in the council ring, across the bridge!
quest.guhs.ringh2.bel.te_vroeg: The council only starts once you know everyone. You still need to meet: %s.
quest.guhs.ringh2.bel.eerst_guhrond: Not so fast with that bell! Talk to Guhrond first, on the doorstep of the hall.
quest.guhs.ringh2.bel.galm: The bell echoes over the waterfalls. Lovely sound, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.raad.na: Tell Guhrond that you'll carry the ring. He's on his high seat in the council ring.
quest.guhs.ringh2.genootschap.na: Guhrond gives you provisions for the road: cheese nibbles and two of the house stews. Don't eat it all at once!
quest.guhs.ringh2.genootschap.hint: Talk to Guhdalf when you're ready to set off.
quest.guhs.ringh2.klaar: Chapter 2 is done! The Fellowship is on its way to the Mines of Nibblemoria. Your Journey Map is in the Guhdex.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.welkom.0: Welcome to Guhvendell, ring-bearer. I am Guhrond. This house is three thousand years old. So is the cheese sauce. Better not taste it.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.welkom.1: Tonight there's a council about that nibble in your pocket. Go meet the others first. They're wandering around all over the place, eating my supplies.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.welkom.hint: Meet Araguh, Leguhlas, Gimguh, Boromika, Merry and Pippguh.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.nog: You haven't met everyone yet. You still need to meet: %s. Look by the gate, in the garden, in the hall and in the kitchen.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.bel: Everyone is here. Ring the bell in the council ring, across the bridge. Then they'll come by themselves. Usually.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.wie: They've been bickering for hours. Someone has to take the ring to Mount Fry. Someone with little paws and a big heart. Who, oh who?
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.nog_niet: Take your time. They'll keep bickering for a while. They can keep that up for three thousand years, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhrond.vertrek: Nine companions. Go with Guhdalf when you're ready. And bring your plate back, or I'll never see it again.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.voor.0: Ha, there you are. Still got the ring? Didn't eat it? Not even a corner? Good, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.voor.1: Guhrond and I have known each other for ages. He still has a frying pan of mine.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.raad: They won't listen to an old wizard. You go say something to Guhrond. You know what.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.vertrek: Our road leads across the Charcoal Flats to the Mines of Nibblemoria. It's dark there, and something very, very peckish lives inside. Are you ready to set off?
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.nog_niet: Feel free to look around a bit more. A wizard never leaves early. He leaves precisely when the cookies are gone.
quest.guhs.ringh2.guhdalf.op_weg: Then off we go! The Fellowship walks with you, even when you can't see them. Follow your Super Compass, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.les: I am Araguh. They call me Guhstrider. Whoever travels with me must know how to sneak. Show me: crouch (sneak) and then click me again.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.niet_gebukt: You're still standing up straight. The Eye can see you from three mountains away like that. Crouch, and then click me.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.kennis: Now THAT is sneaking. Tummy in, ears flat and no saying 'nyeg'. That'll come in handy at the Black Grill Gate.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.praat: I'm keeping an eye on the gate. And on the cookie tin. Mostly the cookie tin.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.bel: The bell? I'm on my way. Sneaking. You won't hear me coming.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.raad: All I'm saying is: whoever carries the ring must know how to sneak. And only one of us here can. Two, counting me.
quest.guhs.ringh2.araguh.klaar: You have my sword. And my packed lunch, if you ask nicely.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.kennis: I am Leguhlas, of the tree guhs. My elf eyes have already found seventeen nibbles today. That dwarf guh over there says seventeen and a half. Halves don't count.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.praat: See that pile? Seventeen of them are mine. The rest were already there.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.bel: I heard the bell before it even rang. Elf ears, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.raad: My elf eyes saw it first. So it's mine. That's how it works.
quest.guhs.ringh2.leguhlas.klaar: You have my bow. I only shoot cheese with it. Slices.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.kennis: Gimguh, son of Gluhin! Seventeen and a half, I've got. The half was under the bench and it DOES count. Just ask nobody.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.praat: Nobody tosses a dwarf guh. But you may toss me a nibble.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.bel: A council! Good. There's always food at those.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.raad: My tooth still hurts. But if I chop it to pieces, everyone gets a taste. Me first.
quest.guhs.ringh2.gimguh.klaar: You have my axe. It's for the cheese. Thick slices, wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.kennis: I am Boromika. Yes, a Mika. But I don't steal! Is that it, in your pocket? Can I just hold it for a sec... No. No, you're right. Sorry, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.praat: The shards of Nibsil. Somebody has been nibbling on them. It wasn't me. Not this time.
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.bel: I'll be right there. I'm just looking at these shards a teeny bit longer. Looking is allowed.
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.raad: I only want to keep it safe. In my mouth. Just for a moment. For safety!
quest.guhs.ringh2.boromika.klaar: I'll carry the buns. There are almost as many in there as this morning.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.kennis: I'm Merry, that's Pippguh. We're here for second breakfast. And third. We don't know what a council is, but there's bound to be food.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.snoep: Oops. There was a cheese nibble in your bag. WAS. It rolled right out, straight into my mouth.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.lege_tas: Your bag is empty! What are we supposed to do about second breakfast now?
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.praat: The buffet is Guhrond's. We're guarding it. From very close up.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.bel: Was that the dinner bell? No? Shame.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.raad: Shhh! We're not here. We're a bush.
quest.guhs.ringh2.merrie.klaar: We're coming too! Someone has to guard the provisions. From very close up.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.kennis: Pippguh! Pleased to meet you. Have you seen that bell yet, in the council ring? Guhrond says I'm not allowed to touch it. I don't know why.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.snoep: That was Merry. I only ate the wrapper. Oh. It didn't have a wrapper.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.lege_tas: There's nothing in your bag. I checked three times. With my little paws.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.praat: I'm not touching anything. That teapot fell all by itself. Almost.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.bel: YOU get to touch the bell? That's not fair, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.raad: I'm a bush too. A peckish bush.
quest.guhs.ringh2.pippguh.klaar: Where are we going, anyway? Doesn't matter. Is there a second breakfast on the way?
gui.guhs.ringh2.optie.nog_niet: Uh... let me think about it a bit
gui.guhs.ringh2.optie.rondkijken: I'll look around a bit more
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.beloning.provi: Guhrond's provisions: 6 cheese nibbles and 2 stews
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.beloning.genoo: The Fellowship of the Nibble Ring: eight companions for the road
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.uitleg: In Guhvendell, the house of Guhrond, a council gathers about the Nibble Ring. Everyone wants to eat it. Someone has to take it to Mount Fry. Nyeg, now who could that be?
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.0: Walk with Sam-guh through the Guhbarbecuether to Guhvendell, the house of Guhrond. Your Super Compass (My Story) shows the way. If you come across a Rest Fire, walk past it for a moment.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.0: Guhvendell, in the Sausage Woods of the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.1: You made it! Talk to Guhrond. He's standing on the doorstep of the big white house with the green roof.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.1: Guhvendell: the doorstep of the hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.2: Meet Araguh, Leguhlas, Gimguh, Boromika, Merry and Pippguh. They're all over Guhvendell: by the gate, in the garden, in the hall and in the kitchen. Guhrond knows who you still need to meet.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.2: Guhvendell: by the gate, in the garden, in the hall and in the kitchen
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.3: Everyone is here. Cross the bridge to the council ring (the round ring of pillars) and ring the bell. Then the Council of Guhrond begins.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.3: Guhvendell: the bell in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.4: The council is bickering over who gets to eat the ring. Tell Guhrond, on his high seat in the council ring, that you'll take it to Mount Fry.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.4: Guhvendell: Guhrond in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.5: You have provisions and eight companions. Feel free to look around a bit more. Talk to Guhdalf in the council ring when you're ready to set off.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.waar.5: Guhvendell: Guhdalf in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.nu.klaar: The Fellowship of the Nibble Ring is on its way! Guhrond stays home and waves. Do drop by again sometime.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.0: Walk to Guhvendell (your Super Compass shows the way)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.1: Talk to Guhrond on the doorstep of the hall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.2: Meet the whole company (six guhs, all over Guhvendell)
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.3: Ring the bell in the council ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.4: Tell Guhrond that you'll carry the ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h2.kort.5: Talk to Guhdalf: ready to set off
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.0: Beyond the grill portal lies the Guhbarbecuether: smoke, embers and the smell of something tasty everywhere.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.1: Deep in the Sausage Woods, where the cheese sauce tumbles off the rocks in waterfalls, stands Guhvendell: the Last Cozy House.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.2: That is where Guhrond lives. For three thousand years he has known what must be done with the Nibble Ring. He's just still looking for someone to do it.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h2.regel.3: Walk there with Sam-guh. Your Super Compass shows the way. And no licking the ring, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.begin: The bell echoes through Guhvendell. The Council of Guhrond gathers.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.welkom: Strangers from distant lands, friends of old. You are here because of one nibble. One VERY tasty one.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.leg: Lay the ring on the stone, little one.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.ring: There it lies. It smells of melted cheese. Everybody gulps.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.geef: So it is true. The Nibble Ring! Give it to me. I'll eat it. For safety, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.frituur: The ring cannot simply be eaten. It must be fried in Mount Fry, where it was baked. And then shared fairly.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.wachten: Then what are we waiting for?
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.tand: OW! My tooth! That ring is rock hard, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.nul: That makes nibble number zero for you, Gimguh. I'm still on seventeen.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.half: Seventeen and a half! The half DOES count!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.wandel: One does not simply walk to Mount Fry. There is an Eye there that never blinks. Well. Almost never.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.ik: I'll carry it. I am almost king, after all.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.ogen: My elf eyes saw it first!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.stukken: I'll chop it to pieces. Fair and square! The biggest piece is mine.
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.dwazen: Fools! There will be NO snacking before dinner!
scene.guhs.ringh2_raad.eind: They bickered and bickered. The ring just lay there. Someone had to say something...
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.ik: I will take the ring! Though I do not know the way.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.stil: It went very quiet. Even the cheese sauce stopped splashing for a moment.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.last: I will help you bear this burden, as long as it is yours to bear. And I'll carry the cookies.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.zwaard: If I can protect you with all that I am, I will. You have my sword.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.bijl: And my axe! And my one good tooth.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.broodjes: You carry the fate of us all, little one. If this is the will of the council, then I will carry the buns.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.hee: Hey! The boss isn't going anywhere without me, nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.scheiden: No, indeed, it is hardly possible to separate you two. Not even when he is invited to a secret council and you are not.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.ook: We're coming too! You'd have to stuff us in a sack to stop us.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.verstand: Anyway, you need someone with brains on this sort of... trip. Quest. Thing.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.afvallen: Well, that rules you out, Pip.
scene.guhs.ringh2_genootschap.negen: Nine companions. So be it. You shall be the Fellowship of the Nibble Ring!
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h2_ra: Ring the council bell in Guhvendell and hear just how many of them want to eat the ring
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h2_ge: Take up the ring and leave Guhvendell with eight companions
structure.guhs.guhvendel.tooltip: The Last Cozy House: Guhrond's elven house beneath three cheese sauce waterfalls, in the Sausage Woods (Guhbarbecuether)
